title: Max severity SAP Commerce Cloud flaw now targeted in attacks
summary: A maximum-severity SAP Commerce Cloud remote code execution vulnerability patched three days ago is already being targeted in attacks, according to threat intelligence company Defused. Update August 14, 11:51 EDT: Added SAP statement.
